result.notes: The coverage is unchanged except for two points. requires_unknown_facts is set to false because the rule covers any residential tenancy. The vacation/recreational exemption for tenancies of 100 days or less is also listed in unverifiable_exemptions, since it depends on the purpose and length of the tenancy, which an address lookup cannot check. The statute sets no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits.
